title: SLO synthesis & smart probes for VPC token-flow and latency
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Problem: Private (VPC) customers are seeing unpredictable regressions after node upgrades and capacity changes because current health checks are single-signal and static. We need a unified, adaptive probe and SLO synthesis system that reasons about latency (p50/p95/p99), error rate, and token throughput saturation to (1) create per-VPC dynamic SLO thresholds, (2) surface composite health status for rollout gating, and (3) be deployable via Terraform modules as part of our IaC for Private deployments.

Approach: Build three probe classes (synthetic path test, passive telemetry rollups, egress token-window probe) and a lightweight SLO synthesizer that computes dynamic thresholds from a rolling 14-day baseline with EWMA smoothing and percentile bucketing by traffic class. The synthesizer will emit rules to our monitoring backend (Prometheus/Thanos/Alertmanager or Datadog depending on customer) and a composite health score service (internal microservice) that takes weighted inputs: p99 latency (40%), 95th error-rate spike (30%), token throughput saturation index (30%). Terraform modules will provision probe CRDs, monitoring rules, and rollout hooks that the upgrade pipeline can call to validate canaries.

Key constraints: must work in air-gapped/private installations, minimal extra cardinality on metrics, and be tolerant of short-lived cold-starts and model-variant-dependent latency profiles.
acceptance_criteria: Terraform module can deploy probe CRDs and monitoring rules in a test VPC without manual steps
Composite health score is computed and exposed at /internal/vpc-health/{vpc_id} with documented schema
Canary upgrade pipeline uses the composite health score and aborts when p99 latency regresses >10% or composite score drops >0.12 within the canary window
Dashboards show historical baseline and the dynamic SLO thresholds per VPC (14d baseline + EWMA)
Synthetic probe overhead is under 2% of normal request volume and passive rollups add negligible cardinality
design_decisions: Use 14-day rolling baseline + EWMA (alpha=0.2) to balance reactivity and noise suppression
Percentile buckets: p50, p95, p99 for latency; error-rate computed as 1-minute and 5-minute windows with anomaly flags
Token throughput saturation computed as tokens/sec normalized to reserved capacity and expressed as a 0..1 index; >0.85 considered saturated
Composite health score ranges 0..1, lower is worse. Thresholds: >0.85 healthy, 0.6..0.85 degraded, <0.6 critical
Expose per-VPC SLO rules as MonitoringRule CRDs so IaC can manage lifecycle; allow optional Datadog compatibility layer
tasks: Spike: prototype queries for baseline synthesis against stored telemetry (done)
Implement SLO synthesizer service (api + scheduler + exporter)
Terraform module: CRD + monitoring-rule templates + rollout hooks
Integrate composite score into upgrade canary pipeline and add abort/rollback action
E2E tests in private testbed with simulated token pressure and latency regressions
Docs: runbook for on-call and user-facing appendix for Private customers
comments: 2026-02-25: Ticket created after postmortem of a private upgrade that caused token throughput collapse in 2 customers. Initial spike approved.
2026-03-02: Spike complete — prototyped PromQL and Datadog queries for p99 and token index; found 20% variance by model size, adjusted EWMA plan.
2026-03-06: Design review with PM and SRE — agreed on composite weights and threshold bands. Action: add per-model adjustment factor in synthesizer.
2026-03-10: Terraform module skeleton PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/infra-private/pulls/1283; needs CRD schema vetting for air-gapped installs.
2026-03-12: Integration tests show false positives on short cold starts for large models; mitigation: ignore spikes shorter than 30s and add warmup window for newly-deployed model versions.

2026-03-14: ARM-family edge nodes exhibit different token serialization timings; flagged as a follow-up task to calibrate baseline per-arch. Blocking: small infra change to expose node-arch label in telemetry.
